scientific_integrity: The complete 209-vector mod-two cocycle basis and cup-square evaluation are reproducible using a standard-library checker; no infinite parameter inference is drawn from this finite result. Publication priority and full proof should be independently reviewed.
scientific_limitations: Ordered two-point deleted product of the two-skeleton of the seven-vertex simplex only; topological homeomorphism, not diffeomorphism or full-family classification. The manifold and simple-connectivity prerequisites are established in the cited papers; the new evenness lemma is checked by complete exact binary cochain enumeration. Priority remains provisional.
title: The seven-vertex deleted-product four-manifold is a connected sum of twenty sphere products
